story-context.principle: Company Admins have one place to manage company details (invoicing), form approval workflow, and assets. All settings follow Form Branding patterns (save, audit, unsaved-changes warning).

in-scope.item: Company Settings Hub: route /dashboard/companies/:companyId/settings; nav: Company Details | Form Approval Workflow | Form Branding | Assets (Images | Terms | Documents | Video)
Entry points: cog on company header; Profile dropdown "Company Settings" (active company; hidden if not admin)
Mobile: hamburger + slide-over nav for <768px; sidebar for tablet/desktop; horizontal tabs fallback
Company Details: display name (platform-wide), legal name, ABN, billing; ABR search (AU) in popup modal; "Enter manually" in modal and form; non-AU/individuals supported
Placeholder company "Your Company" at signup; onboarding Step 2 (company setup) removed — separate story
Form Approval Workflow: CompanyFormTestConfig (test threshold, RequirePublishApproval); help text per PM decisions

Assets Images: grid/list toggle; DnD + file picker; delete confirmation; properties panel (display name, metadata, audit trail); forms-using-image (search DefinitionJSON); image swap (dimensions or aspect ratio match; block if different; warn PNG→JPG)
Assets Terms: separate section; PDF + URL; URL validation; inline fallback to new page; production simulation; Terms component auto-maps to company Terms when defined
ref.AssetType: IMAGE, TERMS, DOCUMENT, VIDEO; Asset.WidthPx/HeightPx nullable for non-image
Help: page header description; second-level menu descriptions; help buttons beside properties (Form Builder pattern)
Save pattern: explicit Save, version history, unsaved-changes warning; toast.success (useToastNotifications)
Platform images: option to turn off; Platform Terms: form per country, force read/accept before company terms

out-of-scope.item: Onboarding refactor (remove company from Step 2) — follow-on

done-criteria.dc: Company Settings hub with nav; entry points: cog + Profile dropdown (active company, hide if not admin)
Company Details: display name, legal name, ABN, billing; ABR popup (AU); "Enter manually"; non-AU/individuals
Form Approval Workflow: test threshold, Require publish approval; help text
Assets: Images (grid/list, DnD+picker, delete confirm, display name, audit trail, forms usage, image swap); Terms (separate, PDF+URL, validation, simulation); asset types IMAGE/TERMS/DOCUMENT/VIDEO
Terms component auto-maps to company Terms when defined
UAT guide executed and marked PASSED

existing-models.model: CompanyID, AssetTypeID; add TERMS, DOCUMENT, VIDEO; WidthPx/HeightPx nullable
